species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 100 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 10–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 100 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
